messages.text:
Jim: Ah, I get it!
That's what you call friendship, huh?{be01}
Cas: Huh? You're saying the friendship
between us bad dudes isn't good enough?

There are good Pokémon,
but there are no bad Pokémon.{be01}
Everything is up to the Trainer.
That's what I think!

You've got only one Pokémon?
But Single Battles are too boring!

What? You've only got one
Pokémon that can fight?{be01}
I cannot take a cheap shot,
fighting two against one!
